name: Valid Accounts
description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts as a means of gaining initial access, persistence, privilege escalation, or defense evasion. Compromised credentials may be used to bypass access controls and blend in with normal activity, making detection harder.
detection: Monitor for anomalous account usage such as logins at unusual times, from unusual locations, or to systems the account does not normally access. Correlate valid-account logins with subsequent suspicious activity.
mitigations: M1018: User Account Management — disable unused accounts
